competency_fulfillment.rationale: Same systemic estimation-composition gap as q2_2/q2_5/q3_3: no sample fuses rounding with division into an actual 'estimate the quotient' prompt; samples alternate between plain division ('670÷10'=67, '108÷2'=54) and standalone rounding ('Round 12 to the nearest 10.'=10) shown separately.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Two DNAs are registered (division 20 combos, rounding 6 combos), but the samples never show them composed into the estimation task this competency requires.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Individual sentences are short and simply worded, appropriate for grade 3 quarter 4, though the two-step estimation reasoning isn't actually surfaced.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: None of the 5 samples round a divisor/dividend and then divide, which is the specific variant this competency needs to demonstrate mastery of.

competency_alignment.rationale: Plain quotient facts and standalone rounding are each individually scoped to other nodes (q4_1, q1_4), not to this composite quotient-estimation competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: 'Round 12 to the nearest 10' is a fairly trivial rounding case that doesn't clearly connect to estimating a 2-3 digit ÷ 1-2 digit quotient as the competency describes.
